produser.consejo: Person or company that organizes and finances a film.

merilis.consejo: MeN- form that expresses the action of publishing or premiere.

judul.consejo: Name of a film, song or text.

singkat.consejo: It describes something of little duration or few words.

berjudul.en: to be entitled; to be held by title
berjudul.consejo: It indicates the title of a work.

novel.consejo: Work of fiction written in prose.

berasal.consejo: It indicates where something's coming from.

lanjutan.consejo: It works that continues a previous story.

sebelumnya.consejo: It means something that happened or existed before.

seorang.consejo: A classifier used to count people.

sebuah.consejo: Frequently classified for counting objects and works.

seekor.consejo: A classifier used to count animals.

hewan.consejo: Being alive is not a plant or a person.

karakter.consejo: A character's quality or way of being.

jujur.consejo: He describes a person who tells the truth.

bijaksana.consejo: He describes a person who makes good decisions.

memainkan.consejo: Acting like a character in a movie or a play.

bersikap.consejo: It describes the way a person acts.

texto: **Produser merilis film ini** means «The producer premires this film». In this form, meN- expresses the action that the subject does.
**Seorang** accompanies a person, **sebuah** to an object and **seekor** to an animal. Spanish usually says «a / a» in all three cases, but Indonesian distinguishes these categories.
